mode_policy: Matched fresh OFF/ON executions of unchanged sources/bindings; historical CN/Fulminate/QCP and required OFF ITP proofs reused by hash. No models or Coq rerun unless an unresolved unmatched VC remains.
memory_definition: GNU time max process RSS KiB per complete CLI invocation, not concurrent process-tree sum. Mean peak is arithmetic mean of per-execution peaks. Remote model memory excluded.
